title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Terms for Moving a Booked Appointment
content:
A member may move a Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment to another date and window offered for its service level. Moving it records the new delivery date and window on the appointment and increases its reschedule count by one.

## Terms in force

1. **Status.** An appointment is rescheduled only while its status is scheduled; once the crew is out for delivery the date can no longer be moved, and a failed attempt is rebooked under the failed-attempt rules instead.
2. **Lead time.** The new date must satisfy the service level's booking lead times measured from the request date.
3. **Same day.** Where the service level does not allow a same-day move, the new date may not be the request date itself.
4. **Limit.** An appointment is moved at most the service level's most-moves number of times. The count is the reschedule count on the appointment record.
5. **Window only.** Changing only the window on the same date counts as a reschedule.

| Appointment status | May it be moved under these terms? |
|---|---|
| Scheduled | Yes, within terms 2 to 4 |
| Out for delivery | No |
| Attempt failed | No; it is rebooked under the failed-attempt rules |

## Points of judgement

- **A level allowing 3 moves (hypothetical), appointment showing a reschedule count of 3.** The appointment has been moved the most times allowed and is not moved again.
- **The same appointment showing a count of 2.** One more move is within the limit.
- **Same date, later window.** This is a reschedule and adds one to the count.
- **Request made on the 10th for a new date of the 10th.** Not allowed where the level does not allow a same-day move.

## Clause no longer in force

The clause providing that a reschedule is free only when at least the reschedule notice days separate the request date from the booked delivery date and the appointment has made fewer than its free reschedules (its reschedule count less the reschedule fees charged), and that otherwise the reschedule fee is charged as a reschedule fee entry whose service date is the new date, is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis for reschedule fees.

superseded_clauses: A reschedule is free only when at least reschedule_notice_days calendar days separate the request date from the booked delivery date and the appointment has made fewer than free_reschedules free reschedules (reschedule_count minus delivery_msr_paid_reschedules); otherwise reschedule_fee_usd is charged as a reschedule_fee entry whose service_date is the new date.
